title: Shattrath City
body: Shattrath, whose name means dwelling of light, was the capital of the draenei on this world, and it fell in the fiercest battle of the orcs' war against them. For years it lay in ruin, until the naaru called the Sha'tar came to Outland to fight the demons and found a remnant of the draenei priesthood, the Aldor, keeping their rites among the ruins. Later a host of blood elves sent by Kael'thas to destroy the city knelt before the naaru A'dal instead, becoming the Scryers. Today it is perhaps the one safe place in Outland.

title: Terrace of Light
body: The Terrace of Light is the heart of Shattrath and the seat of the Sha'tar. In the chamber at its center floats A'dal, leader of the naaru, who speaks without words: visitors feel a soothing light and hear slow chimes, and with them the assurance that they are safe. His will alone, Khadgar warns, keeps the city's enemies from crushing it. Portals around the hall link Shattrath to the capitals of Azeroth.

parts.body: A'dal knew the crystal Spirit's Song at once: Velen left it with his people before his ill-fated journey on the Exodar. Perhaps, the naaru mused, he foresaw that it would come back here.
sources: DB spawns: A'dal 18481 (-1864,5430), Khadgar 18166, Almonen 19216, Tiras'alan 25167, Mehlisah 18893, portals 183317-183327 and 187056 around the chamber

parts.body: Told of the Crimson Sigil, Illidan's elite, A'dal foresaw a day when their dark master would have to answer for his crimes.
sources: DB spawns: A'dal 18481 (-1864,5430), Khadgar 18166, Almonen 19216, Tiras'alan 25167, Mehlisah 18893, portals 183317-183327 and 187056 around the chamber

parts.body: Beneath A'dal now stands an image of the Sunwell's defenses, and the Shattered Sun Offensive sends the willing on to the Isle of Quel'Danas.

title: Khadgar
body: Khadgar was apprentice to Medivh, the Last Guardian, and it was he who learned that his master had been possessed by Sargeras; though he honored Medivh, he slew him. He went into Draenor with Turalyon and the Sons of Lothar, and as that world tore apart they shattered the portal behind them. Trapped in Outland, he sensed the Legion closing in, reached into the Great Dark Beyond and found A'dal and his naaru, and now he stands at A'dal's side.

parts.body: He swears he has learned more from A'dal in five months than in all his years among the libraries of Dalaran.

title: Lower City
body: The Lower City is the lowest ring of Shattrath and the home of its refugees, drawn from every war past and present: Broken and Lost Ones, sporelings and Mag'har, high elves, dwarves, orcs and humans, and arakkoa outcasts who turned from Skettis. Every spare building houses them. At its eastern edge the World's End Tavern serves a stranger crowd still, a mo'arg drinking away his sorrows among them.

parts.body: A representative of the Keepers of Time now drinks at the tavern, musing that this world has been damaged in ways beyond what eyes can see.
Since the war against the Lich King began, battle-mages of the Silver Covenant and the Sunreavers keep posts here, sending fighters north to Wintergrasp.
